data.long_meaning: The name Divesh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Dive' meaning 'to dive' or 'to plunge' and 'Ish' meaning 'God' or 'Lord'. This name symbolizes a deep connection with the divine and a strong spiritual foundation. The name Divesh carries the meaning “Dive, Deep + God, Lord” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Divesh usually hope their child will grow to embody dive, deep + god, lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
